pages.title: My Clips
pages.description: Save a tweaked clip/layer with all its effects, speed, and transform settings. Reuse it across any project - the plugin creates new instances from the same master file, no duplicates.

pages.title: How to Save
pages.description: Select a clip/layer in the timeline, click 'Save Selected', enter a name. Your clip appears under 'My Clips' in the sidebar with a CLIP badge showing effect count.

pages.title: How to Reuse
pages.description: Double-click any My Clips item to add it to your active sequence/comp. Same source file, new instance with all your effects pre-applied.

pages.title: 14 3D Formats
pages.description: New support for GLB, GLTF, STL, 3DS, DAE (Collada), PLY, ABC (Alembic), USD, USDA, USDC, USDZ alongside existing C4D, OBJ, FBX.

notes: Save selected clips/layers with effects for reuse across projects without duplicating master files. Expanded 3D support (14 formats).
